title: Pasta e Fagioli a la Chez Ivano
description: Ground beef, beef broth, lots of garlic, tomatoes, ditalini pasta and kidney beans are seasoned with thyme, basil, oregano and parsley in this traditional soup.
ingredients: 2 (15 ounce) cans kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: In a large pot over medium heat, cook beef until no longer pink. Drain and set aside.

In the same pot, heat the olive oil. Cook onion, celery, garlic and black pepper until vegetables are tender, 10 minutes. Stir in beef broth, crushed tomatoes and tomato paste. Season with thyme, basil, oregano and parsley. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. (At this point, you may put the pot on a back burner to keep warm and continue with the next steps about 1 hour prior to serving, if you wish.)
Stir in the beef and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in the pasta and cook until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in the beans and heat through, 10 to 15 minutes.

video.description: Make a big pot of goodness and please the entire family and special guests with the great Italian flavors and wholesomeness of this classic dish. First brown 3 pounds of ground beef, then in the same pot cook onion, celery and garlic in olive oil. Add beef broth, crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, thyme, basil, oregano and parsley. After it’s simmered for an hour, add cooked ditalini pasta and kidney beans and heat through. Serve big bowls with plenty of toasted bread. A great choice when you have a hungry crowd!
